purpose: Primary-source context for the explicit area term. The Lean proof computes the actual first variation from the local definitions; it does not assume a shape equation quoted from this source.

primary_sources.title: Area-Constrained Planar Elastica
verified_passages: Section 2.1, equation (4): length and area constraints
Section 2.2, equations (7)-(9): shape equation, quartic potential with linear term, conserved phase energy
primary_sources.use: Established area-constrained elastica context; compare the normal orientation and coefficient names before transporting formulas.
primary_sources.scope_difference: The source treats closed loops. Our current formalization uses the actual tangent-angle reconstruction starting at the origin, with fixed endpoint data and the oriented area line integral closed by the endpoint chord. Closed curves are included, but curve closure, embedding, and equality with a positive geometric region area are not inferred.
